name: script_register
description: Register a new script in z-script and publish it (make it executable). Use this when the CEO agent needs to onboard a new automation: a new data fetcher, a deployment hook, a CI helper. Provide the script content (Python, shell, JS) inline. After registration, the script is callable via script_run by its `scriptCode`. Returns the script id. For one-time scripts, prefer publishing=false (default) and just run via script_run. For long-lived scripts you want to invoke repeatedly, set publish=true so the script is queryable in /api/script/list.

scriptCode.description: Unique script identifier. Lowercase + hyphens. e.g. 'z-biz-news-crawler', 'reindex-knowledge', 'db-backup'.

content.description: The script source code. For Python: standard library + aiohttp/requests (no arbitrary packages). For shell: bash-compatible.

description.description: What this script does. 1-2 sentences. Used in /api/script/list.

publish.description: Make this script queryable and executable immediately. Default true. Set false to register as draft.
